technical_requirements: Indexing scale: target 120M docs (clinical notes + attachments), incremental daily delta ~200k
Embeddings: prefer 1536-dense vectors but open to 512 for cost tradeoffs; want vector downsampling config options
Reranking: two-stage retrieval -> neural reranker. Tight SLO: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 200ms for reranker (top-10). End-to-end p95 for query < 400ms.
QPS/Throughput: baseline 5 QPS sustained, burst 40 QPS for peak periods
Cost: target average cost/query <$0.015 (embeddings + reranker + vector store ops), must show cost model and simulation
Security: VPC-only private endpoints, no public internet egress for PHI, support for customer-managed KMS, immutable audit logs per request
Compliance: HIPAA + SOC2 required; ISO27001 desirable; data residency US-only (multi-region redundancy OK within US)
Observability: request-level tracing, token-level cost attribution, per-route latency histograms
Rollouts: canary model rollouts and quick fallback to prior model; require labeled evals/metric tracking for quality regression alerts

use_case_summary: Enterprise RAG search for clinical documentation across hospital clients. Store embeddings for fast recall; run neural reranker to surface most clinically relevant passages. Must control PHI egress, maintain strict access logging, satisfy BAAs and ATO pre-reqs.
